title: The Shot at Parliament (Import)
description:
4 Missions · Single Player vs AI

The assassination of Lupony’s prime minister has shattered a plan to reopen the border with Ursony. The suspects have found protection behind the walls of Greywatch. Lead Lupony’s forces from the closed border station to the fortress and bring the accused home to stand trial.
introduction:
Prologue · The Speech
The prime minister had reached the top of the Parliament steps when the shot rang out. His aide caught him as he fell. The speech he had carried out to read scattered across the wet stone. A woman in the crowd picked up the first page. It began with the departure time of a passenger train.

For twelve years, no passenger service had crossed between Lupony and Ursony. The first train was to leave the following morning. Families on both sides had already bought tickets.

By evening, a railway clerk had identified the fugitives from the descriptions circulated by Lupony’s investigators. She had seen them board a night train under escort. By the next morning, the delegation sent to demand their extradition had confirmation that the men were under guard at Greywatch Fortress. Ursony’s foreign ministry refused to hand them over. The fortress garrison began preparing to move them farther inland.

At the emergency session of Parliament, the acting prime minister read the recovered opening line of the speech aloud. Then she gave the army its orders. Reach Greywatch. Bring the accused back alive. Their testimony belongs in a courtroom.
completionText:
Campaign Complete

At dawn, the commander of Greywatch surrendered. The judicial escort entered the fortress, read the warrants, and brought the accused out through the main gate. By evening they were in Lupony, awaiting trial.

Weeks later, the border station reopened. The same clerk was on duty when the first passenger train came through. In the queue at her window was a woman holding two tickets dated the morning after the shooting. The clerk looked at the date, took out her stamp, and waved her through.

You’ve completed The Shot at Parliament.

missions.title: The Border Crossing
missions.briefing:
Briefing

This station was meant to open at seven this morning. The ticket window is shuttered, and the passenger notices are still pinned to the door. Our clerk is waiting on the Lupony side. Across the tracks, Ursony’s garrison has set up a headquarters in the old customs compound.

The clerk says she saw the suspects through the carriage window as their train slowed. If we can reach the station office, she can show us which line it took. Your engineers are already with you. Use this first engagement to establish a position on the far side of the crossing.

Objective
Occupy all cities and industries

Field note
Select an engineer to build a trench on an eligible hex. Build where an infantry unit can make use of the cover.
missions.victoryText:
Victory · The Night Train

The clerk unlocked the station office herself. The last entry in the movement book showed the night train passing through the northern junction. Beside it, the stationmaster had written a second departure in pencil. A locomotive was being held at the junction to collect the men from Greywatch.

missions.title: The Rail Junction
missions.briefing:
Briefing

The locomotive is still at the junction. The yard crew has been ordered to keep steam up until the fortress calls. Once it leaves, the accused could be taken out of the border hills before we get to Greywatch.

Ursony has turned the railway workshops into a fortified headquarters. The tracks divide the map, with open ground between the sheds. At our end of the yard, the engineers have enough material to reinforce our own headquarters. Decide early how much of your starting budget you need for the fighting ahead.

Objective
Capture the Locomotives position.

Field note
If you upgrade your headquarters, check how much budget remains for reinforcements.
missions.victoryText:
Victory · The Engine Goes Cold

When the garrison surrendered, the yardmaster shut down the waiting locomotive. In the dispatch office, he showed us the order to bring it to Greywatch. The transfer was scheduled for the next morning. With the railway junction in Lupony’s hands, the fortress was left with the road.

missions.title: The Greywatch Line
missions.briefing:
Briefing

Greywatch is visible above the ridge. The road to it runs past a line of trenches Ursony has been digging since the border closed. The garrison there has orders to hold the ridge while the fortress commander arranges another way to move the prisoners.

The ground on the map changes sharply between the bare crest and the wooded slope. Your engineers can build new cover as your units advance. The defenders have engineers of their own.

Objective
Eliminate all enemy units.

Field note
Inspect the existing trenches and the terrain around them before committing units. Plan where your engineers can add cover for a later turn.
missions.victoryText:
Victory · Within Sight of the Gate

The last position on the ridge gave way before dark. A messenger came down from Greywatch carrying the commander’s reply to Lupony’s demand for surrender. The commander confirmed the men were still inside. He refused to release them.

missions.title: Greywatch Fortress
missions.briefing:
Briefing

The commander has called his remaining units back to the fortress. His headquarters sits inside the outer defenses, and his reserves are still strong enough to threaten your starting position. Our own headquarters has already been fortified. Two engineer units are available to extend its defenses or support the advance.

The accused are being held in the old officers’ quarters. A judicial escort will wait beyond our lines until the garrison surrenders. Then the suspects will be taken into custody under the warrants issued in Lupony.

Objective
Destroy the enemy headquarters.

Field note
The fortified enemy headquarters and the two belts of trenches are visible from the start. Allow for the enemy reserves when deciding how many units to commit.
